name: MA Lighting dot2 MSC / grandMA2 MSC

configFields.label: ポート
configFields.help: 機器の説明書にあるポート番号を入れてください

configFields.label: Transmitter Address
configFields.help: Address to send outgoing messages to.

configFields.label: Transmitter Device ID
configFields.help: Set this to a value between 0 and 111 to restrict messages to a device and set Send to to 'Device'.

configFields.label: Transmitter Group ID
configFields.help: Set this to a value between 1 and 15 to restrict messages to a group and set Send to to 'Group'.

configFields.label: Transmitter Send To
configFields.help: If you want to restrict who should react on messages send you can set this to either 'Device' and set the Device ID or 'Group' and set the Group ID accordingly. By default it is set to 'All' so everyo

configFields.label: Receiver Address
configFields.help: Address to listen for incoming messages on.

configFields.label: Receiver Port
configFields.help: Port to listen for incoming messages on (Console ⇒ MSC Out).

configFields.label: Receiver Device ID
configFields.help: Set this to a value between 0 and 111 to only listen for messages received for this device ID. We'll still react on messages send to everyone.

configFields.label: Receiver Group ID
configFields.help: Set this to a value between 1 and 15 to only listen for messages received for this group ID. We'll still react on messages send to everyone.

configFields.label: Receiver Executor List (Comma Separated)
configFields.help: Comma separated list of executors that will be created as variables and updated with their fader position.

configFields.label: Console/onPC Type
configFields.help: Type of Console/onPC you want to communicate with.
